{{Quote|We're in this together until we get out of the system.|[[Marn Hierogryph]], to [[Jarael]]|<ref name="kotor4" />}}
The '''Taris system''' was home to the planet of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and the [[Taris (star)|star of the same name]]. It was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]], [[Taris sector/Legends|Taris sub-sector]]. The system achieved prosperity through its location along the [[Mandalorian Road]], but the development of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] rendered it insignificant. Inside Taris' orbit was located an [[Taris asteroid belt|asteroid field]], including the [[Rogue Moon]].
